triggers.say: El Alamein, October 1942. Two belts of the Devil's Gardens: find the gaps, or bring engineers to clear a lane.
Hurtgen Forest, November 1944. Woods hide you but slow vehicles. The Kall gorge is crossed only at the trails.
Prokhorovka, July 1943. Hold Hill 252.2. Mind the anti-tank ditch: only the causeways cross it.
Seelow Heights, April 1945. Cross the floodplain and the canal, then climb: the heights can only be taken by the roads.
Enemy engineers are wiring the great bridge. It goes up at 7:00.
Twenty seconds: get off the great bridge!
The great bridge is down. The way over now is the ford to the north or the rail bridge to the south.
